description: Source code for a performance tracing target in a Git-related project, defining functions for logging various performance and trace events, and setting up a trace target structure.

methods.name: fn_init
methods.description: Initializes the performance trace target, setting up environment variables and configuration.

methods.name: fn_term
methods.description: Terminates the performance trace target, disabling tracing.

methods.name: perf_fmt_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a formatted trace line prefix with timestamp, thread info, event details, and optional repository and category info.

methods.name: perf_io_write_fl
methods.description: Writes a formatted performance event line to the trace destination.

methods.name: fn_version_fl
methods.description: Logs the version of the software.

methods.name: fn_start_fl
methods.description: Logs the start of an operation with elapsed time and command arguments.

methods.name: fn_exit_fl
methods.description: Logs the exit of an operation with elapsed time and exit code.

methods.name: maybe_append_string_va
methods.description: Appends formatted string to buffer if format is provided.

methods.name: fn_error_va_fl
methods.description: Logs an error event with formatted message.

methods.name: fn_alias_fl
methods.description: Logs an alias event with associated arguments.

methods.name: fn_child_start_fl
methods.description: Logs child process start event with details.

methods.name: fn_region_enter_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Logs region enter event with optional label and category.

methods.name: fn_region_leave_printf_va_fl
methods.description: Logs region leave event with optional label and category.

methods.name: fn_data_fl
methods.description: Logs data event with key-value pair.

methods.name: fn_timer
methods.description: Logs timer event with timing statistics.
